description: This Java source file defines the SecurityConfig class, which configures basic security settings for a Spring Boot application. It sets up role constants, disables CSRF protection, allows access to specific endpoints, and permits all requests by default. It includes placeholder comments indicating future enhancements such as authentication mechanisms.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up security filters and security-related constants in a Spring Boot web application.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, disabling CSRF protection, setting URL access rules, and enabling basic HTTP authentication.
